scope: Read-only source and administrative metadata review. No raw/query/GT/return arrays read in this review, no native/ANN/distance/fit/statistical execution. FIT scientific sources and existing locks unchanged.

split_boundary.current_evidence: prepare_fit inherits registered original config.locked.json/old model-manifest complete SHA plus current stat; fresh hashes the historical TRAIN query/GT/rows files and records them as the same discovery tuple. It administratively fingerprints TRAIN20K and public10K query bytes; fit_preflight records exact_query_byte_overlap=0 for both datasets. This reviewer read that receipt, did not repeat array/hash-overlap work.
split_boundary.what_it_establishes: Frozen file identities and inherited query/GT/rows alignment, with no exactly equal query-vector byte string across these two windows according to recorded preparation. Public10K is already exposed and has only public_test role.
not_established_here: A new held-out or confirmation split.
Semantic or text/image entity disjointness, near-duplicate independence or broader distribution independence.
New global source-ID disjointness inferred from numeric row IDs belonging to different source-file windows.
Fresh independent reconstruction of historical query/GT/row alignment from full source arrays.
split_boundary.wording: Report inherited historical split/file provenance plus the recorded exact-query-byte overlap check; use source-file row-window identity rather than a new global-ID claim. Parent formal preflight must reject any registered source stat change.

fit_cost_boundary.shared_budget: One shared allowance for response generation then compilation per dataset; compiler receives only remaining time, not another allowance. Timeout/error/overrun makes partial models ineligible.
fit_cost_boundary.reported_run_fit_elapsed: Timer starts after job load and before native stage-state write, ends immediately after compiler process exits. Includes process creation/wait lifetimes, native loading/live binding/routing/main/M5/fresh/linear oracle/raw serialization, compiler process imports/input hashes/GT decoding/greedy/model serialization/hashes, and intervening driver work within those endpoints.
excluded_from_this_elapsed: Initial run_fit imports, frozen-source hashes and administrative lock checks before per-dataset timer.
Preparation and native build stages outside that timer.
After-timer manifest read/validation/hash, success receipt writing, next-state/final-state serialization and print/driver shutdown.
fit_cost_boundary.reporting_rule: The measured increment is complete native+compiler child lifetimes, not the entire outer driver or total campaign wall. Preserve actual preparation/build/driver/monitor/receipt overhead separately if recorded; unmeasured administrative elapsed is unknown, not zero. Existing TRAIN debt is retained and never reset.

pair_vs_wide_boundary.controlled: Both tables use only status=2 original M5 TRAIN residual GT_K minus original M5 output; actual K/L separately; same support>=2, b4 per key, unit (query,target) joint greedy, three routed rows and <=12 unique online additional scores; original C and R-score reuse retained. Pair-key miss is empty, no route-only fallback.
pair_vs_wide_boundary.capacity_confound: PAIR conditions on (route,winner), WIDE on route. PAIR can have more distinct keys, total stored target pairs and resident bytes even with equal per-key and maximum online budgets. Real nX/lookup costs may also differ. Thus this control does not isolate conditioning information at equal total model memory or equal actual cost.
pair_vs_wide_boundary.supported_future_claim: If measured stronger, the frozen conditioned-table implementation improves over this same-supervision/maximum-online-budget route-only control. Report rows/pairs/resident/key support, actual nX and whole wall alongside rescue/damage.
unsupported_claims: Conditioning alone causally explains a gain independent of offline memory capacity.
Teacher token coverage is measured TRAIN/test Recall or transferable candidate quality.
All region or multimodal approaches succeed/fail based on this one fixed table comparison.

scientific_claims_pending: All output quality/cost and candidate mechanisms require completed fresh matched native measurement plus independent result audit; no current gain or default replacement is asserted.
